title: Re-blessed golden goldens/a11y_scale/65000ms.png is missing from the PR body's golden re-bless table
evidence:
PR body table (lines 63-67):
| golden | cause |
|---|---|
| `goldens/juice/65000ms.png` | non-involved network receded (43,692 px) |
| `goldens/a11y_{deutan,protan,tritan}/65000ms.png` | same frame under each CVD mode table (43,688 px) |
| `goldens/a11y_reduced/65000ms.png` | same frame, reduced-motion (43,656 px) |

git diff --stat v2..HEAD: " goldens/a11y_scale/65000ms.png | Bin 93968 -> 95879 bytes" (6th changed PNG). `grep -rn "a11y_scale" _pr_body_viscomm_crisis_duck.md _bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/spec-viscomm-crisis-duck.md` returns no matches. demos/a11y_scale.dem:1: "# a11y_scale.dem — Story 7.3: the juice scene at UI scale x1.50" — so its 65s frame carries the crisis.
detail: Briefing AC 5: "enumerate which goldens capture crisis states; regenerate ONLY those, deliberately … List them in the PR body." Six PNGs re-blessed; the table enumerates five — a11y_scale's deliberate re-bless ships with no documented cause row.
recommended_fix: Add the row: `goldens/a11y_scale/65000ms.png` — same juice@65s crisis frame at UI scale ×1.50, non-involved network receded.

title: Verify-table test count is off by one: claims app/render 99/99 (94 + 5 new), actual suite is 100 tests
evidence: _pr_body_viscomm_crisis_duck.md:123: "| `odin test app/render` | 99/99 (94 + 5 new) |". Actual run in the round worktree: "Finished 100 tests in 11.504ms. All tests were successful." The diff adds six @(test) procs to app/render/palette_polish_test.odin: crisis_desat_factor_purity, crisis_recede_is_byte_identity_when_inert, crisis_recede_reaches_the_calm_register, crisis_involvement_predicates, crisis_packet_involvement_chain, route_tie_inline_load_default_is_pinned.
detail: The verify claim miscounts: the diff adds six tests (five crisis-duck plus the W3 route_tie fold); the suite runs 100, all green — "94 + 5 new" omits route_tie_inline_load_default_is_pinned.
recommended_fix: Correct the row (and the spec's verify table) to `100/100 (94 + 6 new)`.

title: Primitive-path node FORM colors recede beyond the spec's closed recede list
evidence:
view.odin:1227-1229 (draw_building primitive path):
	if recede > 0 {
		body = crisis_recede(v, recede, body)
		roof = crisis_recede(v, recede, roof)
	}
view.odin:1694-1695 (draw_router primitive path):
	rl.DrawCircleV(c, r, crisis_recede(v, recede, p.router_body))
	rl.DrawCircleV(c, r * 0.45, crisis_recede(v, recede, p.router_dark))
Also view.odin:1208-1209 recedes p.host_body/p.host_roof. Spec list: "Only the network IDENTITY colors recede: tier bands + casings + lane stripes, packet bodies … family washes + chip glyphs, router tier washes/rings, and the Dublin street blocks."
detail: The spec's recede enumeration covers accents (washes/chips/rings), not form bodies; the primitive path additionally recedes house/host bodies, roofs, and router body/dark core — letter-of-spec drift; the sprite-parity rationale is undocumented.
recommended_fix: Either add the primitive-path form tokens to the spec's recede list with the sprite-parity rationale, or restrict primitive paths to the enumerated accent layers.
